items.label: Waterproof & Comfortable
items.value: This men’s rain suit is specifically designed to shed water effectively while remaining comfortable and dry inside. Its made with high quality material 100%Nylon with coated backing, waterproof rating to 5000mm+. Soft mesh and taffeta lined on jacket keep skin breath and stay all days comfort. Fully seams sealed inside to given ultimate 100% waterproof while keep your dry even during heavy downpours

items.label: Visibility & Packable
items.value: The yellow strip on rain jacket and pants is the 1.2-inch wide reflective trims which is to remain safe visibility and reducing the risks during nighttime activities and works. The classic black and yellow color combination gives this rain coat and pants a stylish and contemporary look. It comes with a uniquely customized storage bag that simplifies packing and carrying--No need to fold the rainwear neatly, just roll it up casually and tuck it into the storage bag

items.label: Multifunctional
items.value: The adjustable hood can be neatly hidden into the collar with a zipper closure when not in use. Double storm flap prevent the water from entering your body. Large-capacity hand pocket ensure your own things keep dry. Ventilated back for extra air flow. Adjustable waist with drawstring can customize your waist fit. Side access pocket designed to conveniently reach your own pocket. Ankle snaps enable quick and secure fitting over your boots

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Guardway rain suits for men waterproof allows anyone to face the elements with full protection and full confidence when your doing outdoor activities or working whether its day or night. Accompany you on any occasion, for example hunting, camping, hiking, riding, cycling, working, and dog walking etc. Staying dry, comfortable, and stylish with our reliable rain gear choice

items.label: Suggestions
items.value: Designed with a relaxed fit based on standard US sizing, this men's raincoat offers ample room to layer your own outer jacket and pants underneath. For the perfect fit, please refer to our detailed size chart before making your purchase to ensure optimal comfort and functionality

items.label: Occasion
items.value: Anniversary, Birthday, Christmas, Father's Day, Grandparent's Day
